subject: Shadow-site addition & renewal: timeline and options
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna.morales@clearline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Shadow-site addition & renewal: timeline and options

Hi Anna,

Quick note as we approach your renewal window (Aug 15): thanks again for the conversation last week about adding a VPC "shadow" site for analytics and non-production workloads. To keep things tidy for procurement I wanted to capture options and timelines in one place so we can align the term and capacity changes with the renewal.

High-level ask from Clearline: add a single isolated VPC in us-west with a dedicated cluster (2x A100 equiv) for analytics & ETL, plus cross-VPC peering for read-only KV cache.

Questions from our side so we can put a clean amendment on your desk:
- Do you want the new VPC to start on the renewal date (Aug 15) or as a mid-term addition?
- Is 2 GPU nodes the right starting point, or should we size for a burstable policy (2 baseline + 1 burst)?
- Any compliance/ingress restrictions our infra team should pre-configure (specific CIDRs, IP allowlists, adjacency to on-prem)?

I attached a quick topology sketch and a draft amendment we can send to procurement. If that looks OK I can loop Ben (cc'd) to finalize pricing and Karthik to confirm service-level expectations.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments:
- shadow-site-topology.pdf (attachment)
- redwood-amendment-draft.docx (attachment)

From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@clearline.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearline.com
Date: 2028-06-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Shadow-site addition & renewal: timeline and options

Vanessa — thanks for pulling this together.

Quick answers:
- We prefer the new VPC to go live on the renewal date (Aug 15) so billing and terms align with our existing contract.
- 2 baseline nodes sounds fine to start; we'd like the option to enable a burst node for peak ETL jobs. Please include burst pricing separately.
- Security: restrict management plane to our ops CIDR (10.20.0.0/24) and require mutual TLS for the peering.

I'll route the amendment to procurement once I have a clear delta on cost and a short runbook for cutover. Looping in ops (ops@clearline.com) to confirm the CIDR and mTLS requirement.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-08T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Shadow-site addition & renewal: timeline and options (internal)

V — quick internal note so we're aligned before we produce a formal amendment for procurement.

Summary / proposal:
- Baseline: 2x A100-equivalent nodes dedicated to the new VPC.
- Burst: optional 1x node available on-demand; pricing: baseline $18k/mo, burst $6k/mo (example; exact list to legal/pricing).
- One-time provisioning/setup fee: $7,500 (includes peering config, mTLS cert onboarding, runbook).
- SLA: standard Dedicated SLA applies; we can offer a 99.9% availability target for the dedicated cluster if they take a 12-month term extension.

Dependencies / ops asks:
- Ops needs Clearline's management CIDR and the cert thumbprint for mTLS before provision.
- Timeline: provision 4-6 weeks from signed amendment + verified CIDR/cert. If they want go-live on Aug 15 we need signed DocuSign by Jul 1 to hit provisioning window.

Next step: Vanessa — confirm pricing bands and whether we want to push the '12-month term extension' as a gating condition for the uplift SLA. If yes, I'll draft the numbers and a short SOW for legal.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Sales Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna.morales@clearline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-09T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Shadow VPC topology + amendment for Aug 15 renewal

Hi Anna — attaching the formal amendment and runbook excerpts as discussed. Short TL;DR below with explicit asks for procurement: 

Proposal highlights:
- Start date: Aug 15 (aligned with existing renewal).
- Capacity: 2x baseline compute nodes (A100-equivalent) + optional 1x burst node (billed when active).
- Pricing (example monthly): baseline $18,000, burst node $6,000, one-time provisioning $7,500.
- Term alignment: option A — add new VPC as a 12-month addendum that renews on Aug 15, 2029; option B — add mid-term for remainder of existing term (prorated) + automatic renewal. We recommend Option A to qualify for the higher SLA.
- Security: management plane restricted to 10.20.0.0/24 (they confirmed) and mTLS for peering.
- Timeline: sign by Jul 1 -> provision complete by Aug 15.

Action items for Clearline procurement (for DocuSign):
1) Confirm Option A vs B (we recommend A).
2) Provide management CIDR and mTLS cert thumbprint.
3) Confirm whether procurement wants a separate line-item for burst capacity.

I've included a DocuSign link to the amendment and a short network diagram in the attachments. If procurement wants legal redlines, we can take those and produce a clean SOW within 48 hours.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sandbox/sign/ABC-Shadow
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/CL-2028-0923

Thanks — I can jump on a 20-min call with procurement this week if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Vanessa — this looks good, thanks. Procurement has asked for Option A (12-month addendum aligned to renewal) and wants burst priced separately; I'm sending the DocuSign to procurement now (procurement@clearline.com).

Procurement note: we'll route to legal for a short review but don't expect major redlines; the critical items for us are the CIDR/mTLS constraints (ops will provide cert thumbprint by EOD Fri).
